correctness.rationale: Exact rational C5/C6 orbit formulas prove all nonadjacent and diagonal signs; Descartes one-sign-change quartic proves the single sharp C6 threshold. value.rationale: The unweighted cycle is the canonical periodic-grid network. The new sharp C6 threshold and all-cycle n=5/6 structural boundary supply a natural and useful exact benchmark for a fourth-order A-stable scheme. An analytic effective-resistance explanation extends the boundary to infinitely many cycle sizes; the result is not merely finite enumeration.
